notes.title: Version 1.2 with big changes coming soon.
notes.content:
Hello,

Today I'm happy to announce that version 1.2 will be coming soon to Pirate Popper VR. We are adding massive changes to the game. See below.

[list]
[*]Progressive Island hopping levels with all new islands. From the tropics to the arctic.
[*]A total of 250 new handmade levels.
[*]All new blockers such as the target that must be shot using the pistol to clear.
[*]A Captains Cabin will be used for the home screen.
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Bug fixes and script clean up offering better performance.
[/list]

We are very excited for everyone to play v1.2 and it should be dropping in a week or two.

notes.title: Out Now
notes.content:
We're happy to announce we've released Pirate Popper VR a day early.
Some updates that has been made in version 1.02

[list]
[*]Bombs, bombs have a random drop chance from the chest. These powerful drops cause a large explosion clearing out entire levels if used correctly.
[*]Small bug fixes
[*]The ingame tutorial board has been moved so it can be seen easily.
[/list]
